input.rationale: There is no limitation of liability, damages exclusion or "aggregate liability" language anywhere in the Agreement — Section 9 contains only authority representations and Section 10 is boilerplate (the only uses of "liability" are the no-joint-venture disclaimers at 10.2). Both parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct and consequential damages. We have inserted a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.

input.quote: (b) HDI acknowledges that the Company is currently a party to a web-hosting agreement with Globix Corporation (the "Globix Agreement")
input.rationale: No indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language appears anywhere (a search for "indemn" returns nothing). HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and processes customer order data, so the absence of an IP-infringement indemnity is walk-away territory. We inserted the standard HDI indemnity (IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice-and-control procedure; the Company gives no reciprocal indemnity, which we have left as is.

input.quote: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
input.rationale: Section 6.1 restrains the Company (our side) from participating in "any project similar to the Site" for Deerskin Products or "products substantially similar" from "companies similar to" the named competitors — an open-ended field-of-use restriction that fails the fallback's requirement of a named competing product, and the only carve-out (6.2 closeout merchandise) does not cover internal development or acquisitions. It is term-only, so not walk-away, but we have narrowed it to a competing Deerskin-branded consumer site with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs.
